title: Widgets, themes and the renderer
summary: See how a block type becomes visible UI and why themes change tokens instead of content.

blocks.title: Widgets are proven operations; themes are setup values
blocks.body: The artifact says what block it contains. The renderer in App.tsx chooses the corresponding React markup and interaction. CSS applies the selected theme's color tokens. This keeps content portable and behavior owned by one reviewed implementation.

columns.name: Artifact

columns.name: Theme
columns.detail: Says: the accent, surface, text and canvas colors for Paper, Signal, Workshop, Night or Field.
